human_reference_unreal_result: No human-cleaned Lantern reference exists. The third isolated arm is explicitly labeled as a Blender 5.1.2 re-export control; it imported at 1.2 meters with one mesh, one material, and three textures.
raw_unreal_result: Unreal 5.8 imported one static mesh, one material, and three textures at a represented 99.9089-meter height with zero errors and the same non-fatal unsupported FB_ngon_encoding warning as the Shepherd arm.
shepherd_unreal_result: Unreal 5.8 imported one static mesh, one material, and three textures at the approved 1.2-meter grounded height. The isolated Unlit visual pass found no silhouette, color, material, texture, normal, opacity, or emissive-behavior regression and emitted zero errors.
visual_fidelity_assessment: Blender 5.1.2 raw-versus-Shepherd turntables match at 0.055-0.082/255 full-frame MAE, and Blender re-export differs from Shepherd by only 0.00028-0.00033/255 MAE. Unreal's individually framed front views match at 0.464/255 raw-foreground MAE. Source and repaired GLBs have byte-identical binary geometry and material, texture, image, sampler, accessor, and buffer-view records; only approved display names and root scale differ. The source export is opaque and non-emissive, so this proves preservation of exported behavior but does not prove that preview-only glass or glow was present in the GLB.
